item.title: Working Class Wednesday event expands to Gadsden County with Black History Edition
item.description: The free networking event will bring and community leaders together to support small business growth in Gadsden County. It will take place at at CJ's Kitchen in Quincy.

item.title: FSU student researchers study ways to prevent heart disease, improve cardiovascular health
item.description: Researchers at Florida State University are studying risk factors and early intervention strategies for heart disease, which accounts for about 21% of all deaths in Florida.

item.title: Sneak peek: FAMU students bring 'Echoes of the Heart: A Musical Revue' to the Essential Theater this week
item.description: FAMU students will debut "Echoes of the Heart: A Musical Revue" at the Essential Theater. The first show is at 8 p.m. Wednesday, Feb. 25. Lead actor Joshua Lyons will serve as the M.C.
